claims.claim: Lecanemab slows clinical decline on the CDR-SB by 27% over 18 months versus placebo in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
Donanemab slows decline on the iADRS by about 35% over 76 weeks in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease with low/medium tau.
Tirzepatide produces mean weight loss of approximately 20-22% at the 15 mg dose over 72 weeks in adults with obesity without diabetes.
Semaglutide 2.4 mg reduces the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events by 20% in adults with established cardiovascular disease and overweight/obesity without diabetes.
MDMA-assisted therapy significantly reduces PTSD symptom severity on the CAPS-5 versus placebo-plus-therapy in moderate-to-severe PTSD.
Aducanumab reduces amyloid plaque and slows clinical decline in early Alzheimer's disease.
Zuranolone provides rapid reduction in depressive symptoms on the HAM-D17 by day 15 in postpartum depression.
Lecanemab in cognitively unimpaired individuals with amyloid pathology delays progression to symptomatic Alzheimer's disease (preclinical/secondary-prevention).
Retatrutide (GGG triple agonist) produces mean weight loss of about 24% at the highest dose over 48 weeks in adults with obesity.
Lecanemab and donanemab meaningfully improve day-to-day cognition such that patients and families notice clear functional benefit.
Mavacamten improves peak oxygen uptake and symptom class in symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
Lecanemab's benefit in ApoE4 homozygotes outweighs the elevated risk of ARIA in that subgroup.
Tofersen slows decline and lowers neurofilament light in SOD1-mutation ALS, though it missed its primary functional endpoint.
Omaveloxolone modestly slows neurological deterioration on the mFARS over 48 weeks in Friedreich's ataxia.
Lenacapavir given twice yearly provides near-complete protection against HIV acquisition in women and gender-diverse populations.
Resmetirom improves NASH resolution and liver fibrosis versus placebo in biopsy-confirmed MASH with moderate-to-advanced fibrosis.
Pimavanserin reduces psychosis symptoms in dementia-related psychosis across dementia subtypes.
Donanemab's benefit is concentrated in the low-tau subgroup, with attenuated or uncertain benefit in high-tau patients.
CagriSema (cagrilintide + semaglutide) achieves roughly 22-23% weight loss at 68 weeks, falling short of the ~25% pre-trial expectation.
Orforglipron, an oral small-molecule GLP-1 agonist, produces meaningful weight loss (~10-15%) in obesity in Phase 2.
Sotatercept reduces pulmonary vascular resistance and improves 6-minute walk distance when added to background therapy in pulmonary arterial hypertension.
Donanemab-treated patients who reach amyloid clearance can stop dosing and retain benefit, supporting a limited-duration treatment paradigm.
Trontinemab (brain-shuttle anti-amyloid antibody) achieves rapid deep amyloid clearance with low ARIA rates in early Alzheimer's disease.
Gantenerumab slows clinical decline in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
